benefits.text: Benefits: BBIA Last Pen Eyeliner Slim - AI Edition liquid eyeliner with an ultra-fine 0.05mm tip delivers subtle, natural color and extends the outer corner of the eye precisely and easily. The product is water-resistant and budge-resistant, and its natural texture helps draw lines in smooth, silky color that does not smudge throughout the day. Versatile, this eyeliner suits many uses, from drawing individual lash strokes to adding graceful accents. Certified vegan by the French organization Eve Vegan.

howToUse.text:
If the color comes out pale, close the cap and shake well before use. 
After use, wipe makeup residue off the tip. 
Close the cap until you hear a "click" and store the product lying horizontally.

safety.text:
For external use on the eye area only; avoid direct contact of the product with the eyes.
If it gets into the eyes, rinse thoroughly with water immediately and stop use if any unusual signs appear.

positioning.text: Ultra-fine liquid eyeliner pen that helps extend the outer corner of the eye precisely and draw natural, subtle lines.

sellingPoints.text: Ultra-fine 0.05 mm tip; subtle, natural color; water-resistant, budge-resistant and certified vegan by Eve Vegan.

texture.text: Ultra-fine-tip liquid eyeliner with smooth, silky ink.

claimDisclaimers.text: Do not claim absolutely waterproof/smudge-proof. For liquid eyeliner pens, close the cap firmly and store horizontally to help minimize the tip drying out.
Do not claim absolutely waterproof/smudge-proof. Muted shades may show lighter than black/dark brown eyeliner.
Do not claim absolutely waterproof/smudge-proof. Light shades will not give as strong a definition as black.
